skill.summary: Read a plain Markdown file (e.g. 260321_openclawConfig.md), generate header and section images using the default OpenClaw image model and API key from ~/open...

latestVersion.changelog:
**Initial release of the Markdown Image Enricher skill.**

- Generates header and section images for a given Markdown file using OpenClaw’s default image model and configured API key.
- Creates an enriched Markdown copy (`*_img.md`) with embedded images, leaving the original file unchanged.
- Automatically moves all generated PNGs into an adjacent `img/` folder and sets correct relative paths in the enriched file.
- Extracts the main title and all section headings from the original Markdown to determine image prompts and insertion points.
- Operates securely and deterministically, never accessing unrelated files or secrets, and never asking users for API keys.
